convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Q2MA' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator buffers and external trade functions make auto-conversion impossible.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose are gated by input booleans BuyPosClose/SellPosClose; when enabled, opposite signal triggers close of existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots (MM=lot size), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of respective margin base. Default LOT mode means MM=0.1 is 0.1 lots fixed.

custom_logic_notes: Invert input flag swaps the Up and Dn indicator buffers, reversing the trading direction. Signal detection uses two consecutive bars: bar[1] must show the crossover condition (Up>Dn or Up<Dn) while bar[0] (previous bar relative to bar[1]) must show the pre-crossover state (Up<=Dn or Up>=Dn). When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates on every tick instead of only on new bars. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans independently gate each of the four trade actions. Recount flag forces re-evaluation when CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: Q2MA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses the SmoothAlgorithms library which provides T3, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, VIDYA, AMA and other advanced smoothing methods - all must be ported. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_ - these must be reimplemented with proper MT5 Python API equivalents. MarginMode enum handling (LOT vs fraction modes) needs careful translation. The crossover detection logic uses CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset to read previous bars, which maps to pandas shift operations. No digit adjustment logic exists - SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips are raw values passed directly to trade functions.
